purpose: choose a realistic set of work for the next iteration, agreed by the team and tied to a clear goal
entry_criteria: Team capacity for the iteration is known
procedure: Set one sprint goal with the product owner that says what value the team will deliver.
Check capacity for the sprint: working days, leave, planned support and carry-over.
Pull items from the top of the backlog that serve the goal, confirming each has clear acceptance criteria.
Break the items into tasks the team can finish in about a day, and surface dependencies and risks.
Check the plan against recent throughput; remove items rather than overload.
Agree the plan with the whole team and publish the goal and the board.
acceptance_criteria: There is one clear sprint goal
Planned work fits capacity and recent throughput

validation.check: compare planned points or items with the average of the last three sprints
check every selected item has acceptance criteria

failure_modes.detection: Sprint is a list of items

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: With 9 working days and one person on leave, the team plans 22 points against a recent average of 24 and sets the goal 'customers can reset their password without support'.
